adjudication.rationale: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts the handler does `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` and then conditionally `create` if none is found. That check-then-act sequence is not atomic and is vulnerable to a race where two concurrent requests for the same (userId, appSlug) both see no existing credential and both execute `prisma.credential.create(...)`, producing duplicates unless there is a DB-level unique constraint (not shown in this diff).
